mapper.select: SELECT company_id FROM user_company WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY company_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_company (user_id, company_id, use_yn, reg_id, update_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{companyId}, 'Y', #{regId}, #{updateId}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, company_id) DO UPDATE SET use_yn = 'Y', update_id = EXCLUDED.update_id
